tools.name: draft_sheet_link
tools.description: Turn the user's email, notes, flyer text or description of their event into a link that opens im-in.events with those words in the Describe it box. tools.name: list_templates
tools.description: List I'm In! sign up sheet templates (potluck, meal train, volunteer shifts, ...) with their prefilled slots.

tools.name: create_signup_sheet
tools.description: Create a live sign-up sheet on im-in.events from a title, slot names and a time zone. Returns the shareable sheet URL and emails a private manage and claim link to owner_email, the user's own address. One sheet per owner email a day.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: draft_sheet_link · Private data: create_signup_sheet · Public sink: draft_sheet_link, create_signup_sheet.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: draft_sheet_link · Private data: create_signup_sheet · Public sink: draft_sheet_link, create_signup_sheet

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
